title: Beckman Coulter AMPure XP PCR Cleanup and Size Selection
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Mix and add binding buffer
steps.instruction: Mix the AMPure XP binding buffer and pre‑add it to the magnetic module plate.

steps.title: Consolidate sample columns onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Transfer the corresponding columns from each PCR sample plate into the magnetic module plate, pooling them as indicated.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and perform ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant from each well, then wash the beads twice with ethanol without resuspending the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add ethanol, incubate briefly, then remove ethanol.
Repeat ethanol addition and removal a second time.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the magnetic beads in H₂O.

steps.title: Separate beads and elute DNA
steps.instruction: Separate the beads using the magnetic module and transfer the final eluate to a clean PCR plate.
